name: As admin: the My Bookmarks page turned off by the setting EnableBookmarksPage (read per request, no restart): after a reload no 'Library tools' link leads to it, its route #/jfbm-bookmarks shows 'My Bookmarks is turned off by your server admin.' under its own title with no 'Page not found', the shell endpoint answers 200 with that note and no page marker, the capabilities say Pages.Bookmarks false, a video's 'My bookmarks' section shows no See all (My Clips, still on, still linked), and the My Clips page's header has no My Bookmarks link; then the setting is put back and the link returns. Changes EnableBookmarksPage through the configuration API and restores it at the end (sandbox data only); makes one bookmark on a movie and deletes it. Run by bookmarks-page-probe.mjs.

steps.name: the page is on to begin with
a bookmark on it through the API, so its page shows the section
steps.script: const b = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 50000000, Name: 'page-probe off check' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return b.Id;

steps.name: EnableBookmarksPage off through the configuration API
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); c.EnableBookmarksPage = false; await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); const r = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); return { EnableBookmarksPage: r.EnableBookmarksPage, PageHostMode: r.PageHostMode };

steps.name: reload, so index.html carries the fragment with the page off
the home page is shown and the script ran
index.html lists the page as off
steps.eval: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => { const s = t.match(/<script type="application\/json" data-jfbm-head data-jfbm-pages>([^<]*)<\/script>/); return s ? JSON.parse(s[1]) : null; })

steps.name: drawer open
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .userMenuOptions'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()

steps.name: the note under the page's own title, no 'Page not found', no toolbar
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="off"]'); if (!r) return false; const nf = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > :not([data-jfbm-page]) h1')].some(h => h.getClientRects().length > 0); return { note: (r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-note') || { textContent: '' }).textContent, toolbar: !!r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-toolbar'), notFound: nf, title: (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim() }; })()

steps.name: as expected
steps.assert: __vars.route.note === 'My Bookmarks is turned off by your server admin.' && !__vars.route.toolbar && !__vars.route.notFound && __vars.route.title === 'My Bookmarks'

steps.name: the shell: 200 text/html, the note, no page marker
steps.script: const a = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Pages/bookmarks'), { headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } }); const t = await a.text(); return { status: a.status, type: a.headers.get('content-type'), note: t.includes('My Bookmarks is turned off by your server admin.'), marker: t.includes('data-jfbm-page=') };

steps.name: 'My bookmarks (n)' without See all (no page to link), My Clips still linked
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!s || s.classList.contains('hide') || !/^My bookmarks \(\d+\)$/.test(s.querySelector('h2').textContent)) return false; const l = s.querySelector('.jfbm-section-links'); const links = l ? [...l.querySelectorAll('a')] : []; return !!l && !l.classList.contains('hide') && links.length === 1 && links[0].getAttribute('data-jfbm-link') === 'clips' && links[0].textContent.trim() === 'My Clips'; })()

steps.name: the My Clips page, its header without a My Bookmarks link
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="clips"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy')) return false; const h = r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-header'); return !!h && !h.querySelector('a') && !r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-bookmarks-link'); })()

steps.name: EnableBookmarksPage back on
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); c.EnableBookmarksPage = true; await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); return (await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id)).EnableBookmarksPage;

steps.name: the bookmark deleted
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.bookmarkId, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); return true;

steps.name: reload, so index.html carries the fragment with the page on again
the home page is shown and the script ran
the link is back
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .jfkit-nav a[data-jfbm-nav="bookmarks"]'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()

steps.name: the capabilities offer the page again
